user.title: New configuration
user.description: Choose the entity type to configure.

light_group_plus.title: Light Group+
light_group_plus.description: Create a light group whose effects activate native Home Assistant scenes. Effect names come from the visible scene names.

data_description.scene_entity_ids: The order is preserved in the light effect list.
data_description.default_scene_entity_id: This scene must also be selected in Scenes.

configuration.title: Meter configuration
configuration.description: Configure individual sensors, groups, device links, and an optional current price per {price_unit}.

data_description.individual_sources: Add each sensor and choose whether its virtual meter stays separate from the source device.
data_description.groups: Each named group receives a virtual device containing the sum of its members.
data_description.price_entity_id: Leave empty to omit cost sensors. Historical price changes are applied when they occurred.

sources.title: Individual sensors
sources.description: Select compatible individual sensors and, if needed, a current price per {price_unit}. Groups are configured next.

data_description.source_entity_ids: Each selected sensor receives its own derived sensors.
data_description.price_entity_id: Leave empty to omit cost sensors. Historical price changes are applied when they occurred.

source_options.title: Device links
source_options.description: Choose which individual derived sensors belong to the source device.

manage_groups.title: Groups
manage_groups.description: Add or edit named groups, return to the individual sensors, or save this configuration.

add_group.title: Add group
add_group.description: A group receives a virtual device containing the sum of its members.

error.no_targets: Select at least one individual sensor or create a group.
error.invalid_sources: One or more sensors no longer match this source type.
error.duplicate_source: An individual sensor can only be added once.
error.invalid_price: The selected price entity must currently contain a non-negative number.
error.duplicate_group_name: A group already uses this name.
error.default_scene_not_selected: The default scene must be included in the selected scenes.
error.duplicate_entity: Each member light and scene can only be selected once.
error.missing_entity: One or more selected lights or scenes are unavailable.
error.duplicate_scene_name: Every selected scene must have a unique visible name.
